result.Method of Attack: Delivered as obfuscated .NET binary ransomware that encrypts personal files, deletes backup copies and backup catalog, disables recovery mode and Task Manager, and demands ransom payment in Bitcoin; Copies itself to %Appdata% as svchost.exe to evade detection; Removes Volume Shadow copies and Windows Backup catalog to prevent recovery; Disables Task Manager via Windows Registry modification; Encrypts user-accessible files with predefined extensions and appends random four-character extension; Drops ransom note read_it.txt in encrypted directories
result.Impacted Systems: Windows systems with user-accessible file directories
result.Attack Vector: Obfuscated .NET binary executed on Windows, evasion by location check and renaming to svchost.exe
result.Indicators of Compromise: MD5sum: ae3dd3d1eedb6835e6746d51d9ab21c6; Registry key: HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\DisableTaskMgr = 1; Command lines: Vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet, Wmic shadowcopy delete, Wbadmin delete catalog –quiet; File: %APPDATA%\svchost.exe; Ransom note file: read_it.txt
